Types

Frozen dataclasses used as the contract between the data layer, the model, and the pricer.

All dataclasses below are intentionally frozen and carry only tensors / metadata — treat them as immutable bundles. They are NOT meant to be compared by value (tensor __eq__ is elementwise and would either misfire or be expensive).

class src.types.data_types.EncoderInputs(curve_history, short_rate=None, dates=None)[source]

Bases: object

Encoder input bundle.

Variables:

  • curve_history (Union[Tensor, Tuple[Tensor, Tensor]]) – Yield-curve history. For ‘simple’ encoders: a Tensor of shape (T, M). For ‘hierarchical’ encoders: a tuple (fast_history, slow_history).

  • short_rate (Optional[Union[Tensor, Tuple[Tensor, Tensor]]]) – Optional short-rate history aligned with curve_history. Same shape convention as curve_history. May be None.

  • dates (Optional[list]) – Optional list of timestamps aligned with curve_history rows (debug / plotting only — never used by the encoder forward).

Parameters:

  • curve_history (Union[Tensor, Tuple[Tensor, Tensor]])

  • short_rate (Union[Tensor, Tuple[Tensor, Tensor], None])

  • dates (Optional[list])

curve_history: Tensor | Tuple[Tensor, Tensor]
short_rate: Tensor | Tuple[Tensor, Tensor] | None = None
dates: list | None = None
class src.types.data_types.BondFeatures(ids, features, feature_names, asof_date, metadata=<factory>)[source]

Bases: object

Fixed-size bond features evaluated at a given reference date.

Variables:

  • ids (List[str]) – Bond identifiers in the same order as rows of features.

  • features (Tensor) – Feature matrix of shape (N_bonds, d_features).

  • feature_names (List[str]) – Column names for features, length d_features.

  • asof_date (pd.Timestamp) – Reference date at which the features were computed.

  • metadata (Dict[str, Any]) – Free-form metadata bag (provenance, warnings, etc.).

Parameters:

  • features (Tensor)

  • asof_date (Timestamp)

class src.types.data_types.MarketSnapshot(date, yield_curve=None, short_rate=None, bonds=None, bonds_metadata=None, futures=None, meta=<factory>)[source]

Bases: object

Pricing template for a single date.

Variables:

  • date (Date) – As-of date.

  • yield_curve (Optional[YieldCurveTarget]) – Yield curve target. Usually present on every canonical date.

  • short_rate (Optional[ShortRateTarget]) – Optional scalar short-rate target.

  • bonds (Optional[BondTarget]) – Optional bond price observations.

  • bonds_metadata (Optional[BondFeatures]) – Pre-computed bond features for any bonds referenced by bonds and/or by futures.deliverable_ids_flat. None if no bonds/futures are active.

  • futures (Optional[BatchedFuturesTarget]) – Optional batch of futures targets.

  • meta (Dict[str, Any]) – Free-form metadata.

Parameters:

  • date (str | datetime | Timestamp)

  • yield_curve (YieldCurveTarget | None)

  • short_rate (ShortRateTarget | None)

  • bonds (BondTarget | None)

  • bonds_metadata (BondFeatures | None)

  • futures (BatchedFuturesTarget | None)

  • meta (Dict[str, Any])

Notes

Missing instruments are represented as None. Conventions (e.g. yield maturities) are read from the corresponding target object.

Parameters:

  • date (Union[str, datetime, Timestamp])

  • yield_curve (Optional[YieldCurveTarget])

  • short_rate (Optional[ShortRateTarget])

  • bonds (Optional[BondTarget])

  • bonds_metadata (Optional[BondFeatures])

  • futures (Optional[BatchedFuturesTarget])

  • meta (Dict[str, Any])

src.types.types_utils.merge_single_future_targets(targets, *, device=None)[source]

Merge a list of SingleFutureTarget (all at the same as-of date) into a single BatchedFuturesTarget using a flattened-ragged layout.

Parameters:

  • targets (List[SingleFutureTarget]) – Non-empty list of single-future targets sharing the same date.

  • device (Optional[torch.device]) – Device for the output tensors. Defaults to the device of targets[0].price.

Returns:

Batched representation suitable for vectorised pricing.

Return type:

BatchedFuturesTarget

Raises:

ValueError – If targets is empty, or any target has a different as-of date, or basket / conversion-factor shapes are inconsistent.
